Usage: droide daemon [options]

Run the daemon server

Options:
  -p, --port <number>   TCP port to listen on
  --host <address>      Host address to bind to (default: "127.0.0.1")
  --unix <path>         Unix socket path (alternative to TCP)
  -d, --debug           Enable debug logging (default: false)
  --listen <transport>  Daemon transport to listen on (choices: "websocket",
                        "ipc", default: "websocket")
  --droide-path <path>  Path to droide executable for spawning sessions
  --liveness-fd <fd>    Monitor parent process liveness via inherited pipe
  --parent-pid <pid>    Monitor parent process
  --remote-control      Enable Remote Control
  --remote-access       Alias for --remote-control (default: false)
  --settings <path>     Path to runtime settings file merged for this process
                        only
  -h, --help            display help for command
